skills.name: codebase-design
skills.rationale: Prose-only design guidance (SKILL.md plus DEEPENING, DESIGN-IT-TWICE, EXAMPLES references); no executable code. Applied through agent judgment in design sessions; the boundary with domain-modeling is guarded from the domain-modeling trigger fixtures.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.rationale: Prose-only research procedure (SKILL.md plus REFERENCE and MAINTENANCE); no executable code. The scope boundary with research is guarded by trigger fixtures.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.rationale: scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh is a non-executable template copied into consuming repos, which own its runtime behavior; no executable code ships in this repo. The observed-failure-scope routing boundary is guarded by trigger fixtures.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.rationale: Prose-only modeling guidance (SKILL.md plus ADR-FORMAT and CONTEXT-FORMAT references); no executable code. The routine-vocabulary-lookup refusal boundary is guarded by trigger fixtures.

skills.name: grilling
skills.rationale: Prose-only interview procedure (SKILL.md plus QUESTION-FORMAT); no executable code. The explicit ask-to-be-grilled trigger is guarded by trigger fixtures.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.rationale: Prose-only wrapper pairing the grilling and domain-modeling skills; no executable code and no independent routing surface beyond the two skills it invokes.

skills.name: handoff
skills.rationale: Prose-only compaction procedure; no executable code. Output quality is agent judgment over the current conversation, with no stable executable surface to regression-test.

skills.name: herdr
skills.rationale: Prose-only command and control reference; the Herdr tool itself is external and exercised by its own project. The explicit-request gate (HERDR_ENV=1) is guarded by trigger fixtures.

skills.name: implement
skills.rationale: Prose-only workflow from spec or tickets to a verified commit; verification tooling is repo-local at runtime, and no executable code ships in the skill.

skills.name: pr

skills.rationale: Prose-only guidance for throwaway exploratory builds; no executable code.
